About this ranking

This page mirrors the live UTD Tier List ranking for Ultimate Tower Defense (Roblox). Units are ordered #1, #2, #3 … by area damage, the same metric utd-tierlist.com uses, with the exact values the site displays.

How area damage is calculated

Area damage = raw damage × area factor ÷ 4, then scaled to the unit’s max rarity and today’s meta bonuses. Area factors: one target ×1, small area ×2.5, circle / line / cone ×4, everything in range ×8. A unit that “counts 100% more” doubles again. That’s why a wide-area unit like Betrayer (Monster) outranks a harder-hitting single-target unit.

Meta bonuses (“right now”)

New units get a +500% damage bonus on day one that decays over a year. Seasonal units get +250% during their season. This ranking uses the “right now” view, so meta-boosted units appear higher than in the long-term view.

Clicking a unit

Click any unit card to open a details panel with its full stats: area damage, raw damage, DPS, range, cooldown, hits per attack, placement cost, total cost to max, place limit, AoE shape, attack description, and current meta/traits. Each panel links to the unit’s page on the Ultimate Tower Defense wiki. Without JavaScript, cards fall back to opening the wiki directly.

Team Builder & Best Teams

Build a loadout of up to six units in the Team Builder tab — tap the + on any card — and watch combined DPS, area damage and cost update live. The Best Teams tab ships ready-made comps for DPS, quick matches, boss killing, farming, dungeon, PvP, and F2P/limited play; load any of them into the builder in one click. Presets are computed from the live site data, so they track the current meta.
